input_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines in append/observed order
revision_policy: contiguous revision_no starting at 1; UPSERT supersedes current head; WITHDRAWAL targets current active UPSERT
idempotency_policy: same event_id plus identical canonical content is ignored; any changed duplicate fails closed
conflict_policy: unknown targets, cross-chain targets, revision gaps, reused revision_id, backdated revision visibility and schema drift fail closed
